appraisal_events.evidence: le vieillissement d'une telle pensée...laisse échapper un secret si soigneusement enfoui pendant quarante ans; il n'y avait entre le sévère Charlus tout de noir habillé...que j'avais connu, et les jeunes gens fardés, chargés de bijoux, que cette différence purement apparente...; on voyait que M. de Charlus avait vieilli à des signes tout différents.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator shows Charlus's long-hidden vice now surfacing uncontrollably in his speech, tics, and manner, asserting he has come to resemble the very 'invertis' he once affected to despise, and marking visible signs of his aging.

appraisal_events.evidence: Morel, froussard autant que vaniteux, et reniant M. de Charlus aussi volontiers qu'il se parait de lui; Léa's letter reveals Morel maintains passionate liaisons with several other women behind Charlus's back; la moquerie de Morel à l'égard de M. de Charlus.
appraisal_events.explanation: Morel is exposed as cowardly, vain, and duplicitous, mocking Charlus behind his back and concealing an extensive hidden life with women even as he depends on the baron.

appraisal_events.evidence: le baron fut plongé dans la douleur et dans la stupéfaction par une lettre...le baron était surtout troublé...se sentait torturé par une inquiétude de l'intelligence autant que du cœur.
appraisal_events.explanation: Charlus's jealous devotion to Morel leaves him wounded, bewildered, and tormented upon discovering the extent of Morel's hidden life, showing him as emotionally subordinate and vulnerable in the relationship.

status_effects.explanation: Charlus is diminished as his once-carefully-hidden vice now surfaces uncontrollably in his manner and speech, aging and exposing him.
Morel is diminished by the revelation of his cowardice, vanity, mockery of Charlus, and extensive concealed affairs.
Charlus loses emotional footing, tormented and bewildered by the discovery of Morel's hidden life, showing his dependency and vulnerability.
